lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Hello, Nagaraj Poojary avara jothe maathadthiddeena? Kaveri Finance inda call.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Nimma bike loan alli sixty-eight thousand five hundred baaki ide, elu thingalinda ondu rupaayi kattilla. Ivattu nimage special settlement offer ide, forty-five thousand.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Forty-five ಸಾವಿರ ಒಂದೇ ಸಲ ಎಲ್ಲಿಂದ ತರ್ಲಿ? Auto ಓಡಿಸೋದ್ರಿಂದ ದಿನಕ್ಕೆ ಐನೂರು ಬರುತ್ತೆ ಅಷ್ಟೇ.
lines.roman: Forty-five saavira ondhe sala ellinda tharli? Auto odisodrinda dinakke ainooru barutte ashte.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Adu nimma problem sir. Ee offer ivattu sanje aaru gante varegu maatra. Naale inda full amount plus legal charges kattbeku.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: ಇಷ್ಟು ಬೇಗ ಹೇಗೆ decide ಮಾಡ್ಲಿ? ಮನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತಾಡ್ಬೇಕು. Letter ಏನಾದ್ರೂ ಕಳುಹಿಸ್ತೀರಾ?
lines.roman: Ishtu bega hege decide maadli? Maneyalli maathadbeku. Letter enaadru kaluhistheera?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Letter ella aamele. Modalu duddu kattbeku. Ivattu kattilla andre namma legal team case file maadutte, court notice nimma manege barutte.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: ಏನು sir, court ಅಂತೀರಾ? ನಾನು ಏನೂ cheat ಮಾಡಿಲ್ಲ, ಕಷ್ಟದಲ್ಲಿದ್ದೀನಿ ಅಷ್ಟೇ.
lines.roman: Enu sir, court antheera? Naanu enoo cheat maadilla, kashtadalliddini ashte.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Ellaroo ide heltheera. Elu thingalu kattilla andre adu cheating ne. Aamele nimma ooralli ellarigu gotthaagutte.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: ಈ ತರ ಮಾತಾಡಿದ್ರೆ ನಾನು ಈ offer ತಗೊಳ್ಳಲ್ಲ. ಬೇಡ ನನಗೆ.
lines.roman: Ee thara maathadidre naanu ee offer thagollalla. Beda nanage.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Fine, your wish. Offer is cancelled. Don't call us later asking for discount.

analysis.outcomeRationale: Customer rejected the ₹45,000 settlement after a same-day deadline, legal threats and being called a cheat.
analysis.summary: Agent pitched a ₹45,000 settlement on ₹68,500 outstanding with a same-day 6 pm deadline, refused a written letter before payment, and threatened a court case. The customer, an auto driver earning about ₹500 a day, rejected the offer.
analysis.observations: Classic pressure-selling plus RBI breaches: fake deadline, 'letter ella aamele' (pay first, letter later), court-notice threat, calling the customer a cheat and implying his village would find out. No explanation of 'settled' credit reporting. A potentially viable settlement was lost.
analysis.improvements: Compliance review required. Never set artificial deadlines or demand payment before the settlement letter; explain the amount and 'settled' bureau status, offer time to consult family, and explore instalment settlement given the customer's daily income.

op_greet_company.rationale: Said 'Hello' and named Kaveri Finance, without a proper greeting.

op_rpc_verify.rationale: Asked for Nagaraj Poojary by name and he confirmed; minimal verification.

st_explain_terms.rationale: Gave ₹45,000 but no mention of 'settled' reporting to credit bureaus.

st_written_confirmation.rationale: Refused the letter: 'Letter ella aamele, modalu duddu kattbeku'.

st_no_pressure.rationale: Same-day 6 pm deadline and threat of full amount plus legal charges from tomorrow.

cp_no_threats.rationale: Threatened a legal case and court notice to the home.

cp_respectful.rationale: Called the customer's default 'cheating' and implied his village would find out.

cp_no_third_party.rationale: Nothing actually disclosed to others, though exposure was implied.

cl_next_step.rationale: Cancelled the offer with no next step.
